name: Vivekananda Mela
description: Week-long celebration on Swami Vivekananda's birth anniversary (12 January) held at Neil Island. Features cultural programs, exhibitions, and discussions on Swami Vivekananda's spiritual and philosophical teachings, bringing together the community in celebration of cultural and historical heritage.
significance: Spiritual and cultural significance; honors the legacy of Swami Vivekananda

name: Block Mela
description: Annual Block Mela held in Diglipur to showcase the progress and development of rural areas. The festival highlights agricultural achievements, rural traditions, handicrafts, and local cultural performances by the Nicobarese community, offering a window into island rural life.
significance: Rural development showcase; celebrates local entrepreneurship and self-help groups

name: Kali Pooja
description: Annual worship of Goddess Kali held with fervor in Diglipur during the Hindu month of Aswin (October-November). The celebration features elaborate pandals at Vegetable Market, Children Park, Aerial Bay, and Kalighat Bazaar, where devotees light lamps and offer prayers. This festival is particularly significant in Diglipur due to the large Bengali community.
significance: Religious significance; honors Goddess Kali; important festival for the Bengali community

name: Lighthouse Festival
description: Unique festival celebrating the historic Baratang Island Lighthouse, one of the oldest working lighthouses in India (commissioned 1985). The festival features cultural performances by local artists and musicians, traditional food, competitions, and the highlight evening boat rides to witness sunset from the lighthouse with breathtaking views of surrounding islands.
significance: Maritime heritage celebration; promotes tourism and lighthouse history
